> 第五章 讲武堂（第1页）
山中方外，从无甲子纪年，寒来暑往间，四载光阴倏忽而过。
瑞安王与王妃居于碧霄仙宗，早已成了宗门里人人称羡的一段佳话。二人本是凡尘俗世的凡胎肉身，却在这缥缈仙山之中，活出了一对神仙眷侣的模样。他们性子温雅冲淡，从无半分争竞之心，平日里或莳花弄草，或品茗对弈，岁月在他们身上沉淀出的，是不染尘俗的平和温润。
长子秦翊，如今已是十三岁的少年。四年时光，他的修为一路高歌猛进，如今已然登临练气大圆满之境，只待一个契机，便可冲击筑基大道。在同辈弟子之中，秦翊的天资与实力，早已隐隐有了魁首之姿——寻常筑基初期修士绝非他的对手，便是遇上筑基中期的强者，他也能凭一身凌厉战力周旋，立于不败之地。
次子秦枫，今年刚满四岁。他三岁便开蒙启智，短短一年光阴，不仅将大昭王朝的常用文字识得八九不离十，更在仙山浓郁的灵气滋养下，对修仙界的灵文有了不少涉猎。
恰逢金秋十月，天高云淡，正是碧霄仙宗五年一度新弟子入宗时节。山门之外，来自大昭十三州的少年们云集于此——各州将灵根中上之辈遴选出来，送往仙宗深造，此番足有五百余人；至于灵根稍逊者，则留在各州仙坛，由仙坛长老开仙路，如能三十岁以前达练气圆满，也能进宗续仙缘。
秦枫也在这一批新弟子里，踏入了宗门专为初入门径弟子开设的讲武堂。
他被分在这一届第一队，队内三十二名弟子，尽皆是上品乃至极品灵根的苗子。按宗门规矩，每位新入门的弟子，都能领到一部普及的入门功法——《练气诀》。这功法虽算不得顶尖，却胜在稳扎稳打，待修士将其修至第三层后，便可凭弟子身份牌前往藏经阁，免费择取一门契合自身的炼气功法与一门术法一门武技，足以支撑着一路修行至筑基之境。
但秦枫不同。他的修行之路，自始至终都有宗门老祖亲自过问，所授功法，乃是老祖穷尽毕生所学，遍览天下修行典籍，又经无数次推演论证，方才自创而出的无上仙经——《五行经》。此经玄妙无穷，不仅能让修士凝练出金木水火土五种本源灵力，更可一路修行，直抵元婴巅峰之境，放眼整个碧霄仙宗，都是独一份的机缘。
在讲武堂的入门弟子之中，不乏有宗门世家出身的子弟，他们携带着家族传承的功法，根基深厚；而那些寒门出身的弟子，若想求得一部上乘功法，便靠着日积月累的宗门贡献点，或是寻得珍稀宝物，与宗门等价交换。
秦枫的到来，无疑成了入门弟子之中最耀眼的焦点。
宗门上下，谁人不知他是天才秦翊的弟弟？老祖对外只言秦枫是中等土灵根，可明眼人谁又会真的相信？即便是秦枫当真只有中等土灵根，凭着宗门的资源倾斜，他日修行至结丹后期，也不过是水到渠成的事情。
新弟子的加入，如同一汪清泉注入古井，让往日里清冷寂静的讲武堂，霎时间热闹了起来。少年们的笑语声、切磋时的呼喝声、诵读灵文的朗朗声，交织成一片蓬勃的朝气，回荡在殿宇廊庑之间。
不过月余光景，这份热闹便渐渐平息，讲武堂又恢复了往日的沉静。新入门弟子褪去了初入仙宗的浮躁，将所有心思都沉敛到了修行之中。毕竟在这仙途漫漫、强者为尊的修仙界，唯有实力，才是立身的根本。

The latest chapter of The Twelve Extremes of Immortality_Chapter 5 The Martial Arts Hall Page 1_The Years of the Twelve Extremes of Immortality_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 5 Lecture Hall (Page 1)
In the mountains and outside, there is no Jiazi year. Between cold and summer, the four years pass by suddenly.
King Ruian and his wife lived in the Bixiao Immortal Sect, which had long become a legend that everyone in the sect envied. The two of them were originally mortal bodies in the mortal world, but in this ethereal fairy mountain, they lived like a couple of gods and immortals. They have a gentle and gentle temperament, and never have the slightest intention of competition. On weekdays, they plant flowers and grass, or drink tea and play chess. What the years have deposited in them is a peace and gentleness that is not stained by the world.
The eldest son Qin Yi is now thirteen years old. In the past four years, his cultivation has been advancing rapidly, and now he has reached the stage of perfect Qi training. He is only waiting for an opportunity to hit the path of foundation building. Among the disciples of his generation, Qin Yi's talent and strength have already made him appear to be the leader - ordinary monks in the early stage of foundation building are no match for him, but even if he encounters a strong person in the middle stage of foundation building, he can still fight with his fierce combat power and remain invincible.
The second son Qin Feng has just turned four this year. He became enlightened at the age of three. In just one year, he not only knew the commonly used characters of the Jokhang Dynasty indistinguishably, but also, nourished by the rich spiritual energy of the Immortal Mountain, he had a lot of knowledge about the spiritual texts of the world of immortality.
It coincides with the tenth month of the golden autumn, when the sky is high and the clouds are clear, it is the time when new disciples of the Bixiao Immortal Sect enter the sect every five years. Outside the mountain gate, young people from the thirteen states of Dazhao gathered here - each state selected those with middle and superior spiritual abilities and sent them to the Immortal Sect for further study. This time, there were more than 500 people; as for those with weaker spiritual abilities, they stayed in the immortal altars of various states, and the immortal path was opened by the elders of the immortal altar. If they could reach the perfection of Qi training before the age of thirty, they could also enter the sect to continue their immortality.
Qin Feng was also among this group of new disciples and entered the martial arts hall specially opened by the sect for beginners.
He was assigned to the first team of this year. The thirty-two disciples in the team were all the seedlings of top-grade or even top-grade spiritual roots. According to the sect's rules, every new disciple can receive a popular introductory technique - "Qi Lian Jue". Although this technique is not top-notch, it is better than steady practice. After the monk has cultivated it to the third level, he can go to the Tibetan Scripture Pavilion with his disciple identity card and choose a qi-refining technique, a magic technique, and a martial skill that suits him for free, which is enough to support his practice all the way to the realm of foundation building.
But Qin Feng is different. His cultivation path has been personally supervised by the ancestor of the sect from the beginning to the end. The techniques taught by his ancestor are the supreme immortal scripture - "Five Elements Classic" that the ancestor created by himself after exhausting his lifelong learning, reading all the cultivation classics in the world, and going through countless deductions and arguments. This sutra is infinitely mysterious. It not only allows monks to condense the five original spiritual powers of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, but also allows them to practice all the way to the peak of Nascent Soul. Looking at the entire Bixiao Immortal Sect, it is a unique opportunity.
Among the introductory disciples of the Martial Arts Hall, there are many who come from sects and aristocratic families. They carry with them the skills passed down by their families and have a deep foundation. However, if those disciples from poor families want to obtain a superior skill, they will rely on the sect's accumulated contribution points over time, or find rare treasures and exchange them with the sect at equal value.
Qin Feng's arrival has undoubtedly become the most dazzling focus among the entry-level disciples.
Everyone in the sect doesn't know that he is the younger brother of the genius Qin Yi? The ancestor only said to the outside world that Qin Feng had a medium earth spirit root, but who with discerning eyes would really believe it? Even if Qin Feng really only has medium earth spiritual roots, relying on the resources of the sect, it will be a matter of course for him to practice to the late stage of pill formation in the future.
The addition of new disciples was like a clear spring pouring into an ancient well, making the previously cold and silent martial arts hall suddenly lively. The laughter of the young people, the shouts during the competition, and the loud voices of reciting spiritual texts intertwined into a vigorous vitality that echoed in the corridors of the palace.
It's just a moonlight scene, this excitement isGradually it subsided, and the martial arts hall returned to its former tranquility. The new disciples lost their impetuousness when they first entered the Immortal Sect and concentrated all their thoughts on practice. After all, in this world of immortality where the road to immortality is long and the strong are respected, only strength is the foundation for success.
